easy.def: A word you say to mean not yes.
examples: No, I do not want any.
No, thank you.
No, it is not time yet.

more.def: A word used to give a negative answer, to refuse, or to say that something is not true.
examples: No, I have not finished my homework yet.
The sign said no, so we did not go in.
No, a spider is not an insect.
I have no pencil.
There is no milk left.
No one is home.

more.def: Not any, or not even one.
examples: There were no clouds in the sky all day.
The new puppy has no idea how to sit yet.
We had no school because of the snowstorm.

easy.def: Awake at night and asleep in the day.
examples: Owls are nocturnal.
Bats are nocturnal.
A nocturnal animal sleeps in the day.

more.def: Active at night and resting during the day.
examples: Bats are nocturnal animals that hunt insects after dark.
The zoo has a dark room for nocturnal animals.
Raccoons are nocturnal and often visit at night.
The noisy truck woke me up.
The noisy birds woke me up.
My baby brother is noisy.

more.def: Making a lot of loud sound, or full of loud sounds.
examples: The lunchroom is always noisy at noon.
The noisy fan kept me awake.
We moved away from the noisy road.

easy.def: Silly words or ideas that mean nothing.
examples: That funny poem is full of nonsense.
Stop that nonsense and eat.
The baby talks nonsense.

more.def: Words or ideas that are silly or have no meaning.
examples: He made us laugh by singing a song of pure nonsense.
The idea that the moon is made of cheese is nonsense.
The writer filled his book with funny nonsense words.

easy.def: A word that makes a word mean the other way.
examples: I am not sad.
The soup is not hot.
He did not come.

more.def: A word used to say that something is false or fails to happen, or to turn a word into its opposite.
examples: Penguins can swim, but they cannot fly, and that is not a mistake.
Please do not run in the hallway.
The test was not as hard as I thought.
There is nothing in the box.
I have nothing to eat.
She said nothing.

more.def: Not anything, or no thing at all.
examples: There was nothing left in the bowl except a few crumbs.
He did nothing wrong, so he was not in trouble.
Nothing is faster than light.
Did you notice my new haircut?
I noticed a bug on the wall.
Mom noticed my clean room.

more.def: To become aware of something by seeing, hearing, or feeling it.
examples: He noticed a small crack in the window.
Nobody noticed that the door was open.
I noticed that the days are getting shorter.
I am eating now.
Please come now.
It is snowing now.

more.def: At this moment, or very soon.
examples: The movie is starting now, so please be quiet.
I used to be afraid of the dark, but now I am not.
We must leave now if we want to catch the train.
